name: ML-DSA (Dilithium)
purpose: Code signing, certificates, TLS authentication, document signing.
security: ML-DSA-44 ≈ AES-128, ML-DSA-65 ≈ AES-192, ML-DSA-87 ≈ AES-256
status: Finalized Aug 2024. Widely available in OpenSSL 3.5+.
notes: Signatures ~10x larger than ECDSA — watch MTU/cert chain sizes. Pair with ML-KEM for full PQC TLS.
